info.title: Zscaler Workflow Automation - DLP Incident  Management API
info.description: Zscaler Workflow Automation - DLP Incident Management API.

get.description: Gets the list of all DLP incidents associated with the transaction ID. A transaction ID can contain one or more DLP incidents.

parameters.name: transactionId
parameters.description: The ID of the transaction that violated the DLP rules

delete.description: Deletes the DLP incident for the specified incident ID

get.description: Gets the DLP incident details based on the incident ID

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: The fields associated with the DLP incident. For example, sourceActions, contentInfo, status, resolution, etc.

get.description: Gets the details of updates made to an incident based on the given ID and timeline.
Gets the information of the ticket generated for the incident. For example, ticket type, ticket ID, ticket status, etc.

post.description: Filters a list of DLP incident groups to which the specified incident ID belongs.

requestBody.description: Search request filters the list of DLP incident groups based on the incident ID.

post.description: Updates the status of the incident to resolved and closes the incident with a resolution label and a resolution code.

409.description: Conflict - Request could not be processed

post.description: Adds notes to the incident during updates or status changes

parameters.name: dlpIncidentId
parameters.description: The ID of the incident for which the note is added

requestBody.description: Add notes to the DLP incident request

post.description: Assign lables (a label name and it's associated value) to DLP incidents.

parameters.name: dlpIncidentId
parameters.description: The ID of DLP incident to which the label is assigned

post.description:
Filters DLP incidents based on the given time range and the field values. The supported field values are:
  • Severity
  • Priority
  • Transaction ID
  • Status
  • Source DLP Type
    • The source DLP types that that you can use to filter and search an incident are SaaS Security API, Email, INLINE, and ENDPOINT.
  • Labels
    • To filter DLP incidents based on labels, ensure that you replace the parameter value:[string] with value:[{label_name: [label_value]}] in the request body. You need to provide the label name and its associated value to get accurate results.
  • Incident Group
  • Engine
The supported time range values are:
  • Start date and time
  • End date and time

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Specifies the page number of the incident in a multi-paginated response. Because the page numbering starts from 0, the maximum page number is the total number of pages minus 1 (i.e., total pages - 1). This field is optional if the page ID field is used.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Specifies the page size (i.e., number of incidents per page). The maximum page size is 100.

parameters.name: pageId
parameters.description: Specifies the page ID of the incident in a multi-paginated response. It is a unique identifier returned in the first search request. You can use the page ID instead of the page number in subsequent search requests for faster and more efficient results.

requestBody.description: Search request filters the DLP incidents based on the field value (exact match) or the time range (start and end time).

get.description: Downloads the actual data that triggered the incident

parameters.name: dlpIncidentId
parameters.description: The ID of the incident for which the trigger data is downloaded

parameters.name: fetchTriggerContext
parameters.description: (Optional) Specifies whether to download the complete incident trigger data, including the prefix and suffix information. Set this field to true to fetch the prefix and suffix data.The default value is false.

get.description: Downloads the actual trigger metadata of the incident in a nested structure organized by source category.

parameters.name: dlpIncidentId
parameters.description: The ID of DLP Incident for which trigger data is returned

parameters.name: fetchTriggerContext
parameters.description: Boolean value indicating whether to fetch trigger data context

get.description: Gets the evidence URL of the incident. You can use the evidence link to view and download the XML file with the actual data that triggered the incident.

parameters.name: dlpIncidentId
parameters.description: The ID of the incident for which evidence URL is fetched
